Package
Description
org.clafer.alloy.solve
This package provides the Alloy backend of the solution loop, for temporal models: a port of claferIG that runs Alloy 6.2.0 in the same JVM, finds the traces of a model, reads them from Alloy's XML, and computes unsat cores and their near-misses.
